name: Roof Pitch Calculator
tagline: Roof Pitch Calculator is a free tool for homeowners, contractors, and roofers
description: Roof Pitch Calculator is a free tool for homeowners, contractors, and roofers. Enter rise and run, a degree angle, or a pitch ratio (X:12) to instantly calculate: - Pitch ratio (X:12) - Angle in degrees - Slope percentage - Rafter multiplier - Rafter length **Features:** - Three input modes: Rise & Run, Angle, or Pitch Ratio - Live SVG roof diagram that updates as you type - Common roof pitches reference chart (20+ pitches) - Blog with roofing guides - Runs entirely in the browser — no account,
